NewsArticle.Title: Sgrios Summonings
NewsArticle.Content:
The god of destruction, Sgrios, has been again disturbed from Its eternal gnashing by pointless summoning requests from Its worshippers. The god of destruction, scholars speculate, will devour a worshipper that summons Its creatures without strong reason for disturbing Sgrios.
Succubi may now only be summoned by a level 80+ worshipper, Gargoyles by a level 50+ worshipper. All other creatures are summoned as before.
